name: Benjamin
bio:
Benjamin is the youngest son of Jacob and Rachel, the last of Jacob's twelve sons. Rachel died in difficult labor bearing him on the road to Bethlehem; with her dying breath she named him Ben-oni, "son of my sorrow," but his father Jacob renamed him Benjamin, "son of the right hand," replacing his mother's dying grief with a name of good fortune (Genesis 35:16-19).

Benjamin's birth was bound up with his mother's death, one of the most sorrowful moments in Jacob's family story — Jacob set up a pillar over her grave, showing how deeply he grieved the loss of his wife. Benjamin would go on to play an important role in the story of Joseph — as Rachel's son and Joseph's only full brother, he was deeply loved by both Jacob and Joseph, a story that will be covered in detail as that part of Genesis is added.
